messages.subject: Reactive .Rmd file
parts:
Hello helpful Shinyites,

I created a table for a shiny app that has some odd formatting that I could not get to appear correctly using the R base table function nor the xtables package. Using a .Rmd file I was able to create an HTML table that looked correct. I would like to be able to make that .Rmd file reactive to my user's inputs and then have it output a reactive HTML table to my shiny app. I found one post in this group from a few months back about a "reactiveRmd" function but I was not able to find any documentation or templates about how to use it.  Does anyone have any experience or advice regarding this problem?  

Thank you,
Andy

messages.subject: Re: Reactive .Rmd file
parts: Can you post a sample of what the desired table formatting looks like? Going the reactiveRmd route would be bringing in a lot of machinery, ideally you could either customize xtable with R or CSS, or just make the table yourself with tags$table and friends.
